if Shop1EnhanceManager == nil then
    Shop1EnhanceManager = class({})
end

Shop1EnhanceManager.states = Shop1EnhanceManager.states or {}
Shop1EnhanceManager._event_registered = Shop1EnhanceManager._event_registered or false
Shop1EnhanceManager.source_index = Shop1EnhanceManager.source_index or {}

Shop1EnhanceManager.config = Shop1EnhanceManager.config or {
    choice_count = 3,
    shop_item_id = 2,
}

local RESERVED_KEYS = {
    Open = true,
    Stacks = true,
    Name = true,
    Desc = true,
    Description = true,
    Image = true,
    AbilityImage = true,
    Title = true,
}

local function ResolveEnhanceValue(raw, level)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return raw
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return nil
    end

    local num = tonumber(s)
    if num then
        return num
    end

    local nums = ParseArray(s)
    if #nums > 0 then
        return nums[math.min(level, #nums)]
    end

    local strs = ParseStringArray(s)
    if #strs > 0 then
        return strs[math.min(level, #strs)]
    end

    return s
end

local function GetEnhanceWeight(cfg)
    local weight = tonumber(cfg and cfg.Weight or 1) or 1
    if weight < 0 then
        weight = 0
    end
    if weight > 1000 then
        weight = 1000
    end
    return weight
end

local function PickWeighted(list, weight_fn)
    if not list or #list == 0 then
        return nil, nil
    end
    local total = 0
    for _, name in ipairs(list) do
        local w = tonumber(weight_fn(name)) or 0
        if w > 0 then
            total = total + w
        end
    end
    if total <= 0 then
        local idx = RandomInt(1, #list)
        return list[idx], idx
    end
    local roll = RandomFloat(0, total)
    local acc = 0
    for i, name in ipairs(list) do
        local w = tonumber(weight_fn(name)) or 0
        if w > 0 then
            acc = acc + w
            if roll <= acc then
                return name, i
            end
        end
    end
    return list[#list], #list
end

local function ParsePercentValue(value)
    if type(value) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    local trimmed = string.gsub(value, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
    local num = string.match(trimmed, "^([%-]?%d+%.?%d*)%%%s*$")
    if num then
        return tonumber(num)
    end
    return nil
end

local function ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(raw, level)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "table" then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return tostring(raw)
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return nil
    end

    local tokens = ParseStringArray(s)
    if #tokens > 0 then
        return tokens[math.min(level, #tokens)]
    end

    return s
end

local function ResolveEnhanceNumber(raw, level, base_value)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end

    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return raw
    end

    if type(raw) == "string" then
        local token = ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(raw, level)
        if token ~= nil then
            local percent = ParsePercentValue(token)
            if percent ~= nil then
                local base = tonumber(base_value)
                if base == nil then
                    return nil
                end
                return base * (1 + percent / 100)
            end
            local numeric = tonumber(token)
            if numeric ~= nil then
                return numeric
            end
        end
    end

    local resolved = ResolveEnhanceValue(raw, level)
    if resolved == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local percent = ParsePercentValue(resolved)
    if percent ~= nil then
        local base = tonumber(base_value)
        if base == nil then
            return nil
        end
        return base * (1 + percent / 100)
    end

    if type(resolved) == "string" then
        local numeric = tonumber(resolved)
        if numeric ~= nil then
            return numeric
        end
    end

    return resolved
end

local function SplitByPipe(raw)
    local list = {}
    if raw == nil then
        return list
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    for token in string.gmatch(s, "[^|]+") do
        local trimmed = string.gsub(token, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        if trimmed ~= "" then
            table.insert(list, trimmed)
        end
    end
    return list
end

local function NormalizeList(raw)
    if raw == nil then
        return {}
    end
    if type(raw) == "table" then
        local list = {}
        for k, v in pairs(raw) do
            table.insert(list, k)
            if v ~= nil and v ~= "" then
                table.insert(list, v)
            end
        end
        return list
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return {}
    end

    local pipe = SplitByPipe(s)
    if #pipe > 0 then
        return pipe
    end

    return { raw }
end

local function NormalizePanoramaImagePath(raw)
    if raw == nil then
        return ""
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return ""
    end

    s = string.gsub(s, "%.vtex_c$", ".vtex")
    s = string.gsub(s, "^s2r://panorama/images/", "s2r://panorama/images//")

    local prefix = "panorama/images/"
    if string.sub(s, 1, #prefix) == prefix then
        return "s2r://panorama/images//" .. string.sub(s, #prefix + 1)
    end

    if string.sub(s, 1, #"s2r://") == "s2r://" then
        return s
    end

    return "s2r://" .. s
end

local function GetListValueAt(raw, index)
    local list = NormalizeList(raw)
    if #list == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    local idx = math.min(index or 1, #list)
    return list[idx]
end

local function GetItemFieldValue(kv, key, level)
    if not kv or not key then
        return nil
    end
    local raw = kv[key]
    if raw == nil or raw == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local tokens = ParseStringArray(tostring(raw))
    if #tokens > 0 then
        return tokens[math.min(level or 1, #tokens)]
    end
    return raw
end

local function GetBaseStatValue(item_kv, key, level, overrides)
    if overrides and overrides[key] ~= nil then
        return tonumber(overrides[key])
    end
    if not item_kv then
        return nil
    end
    local raw
    if item_kv.AbilityValues and item_kv.AbilityValues[key] ~= nil then
        raw = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv.AbilityValues, key, level)
    else
        raw = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
    end
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    return tonumber(raw)
end

local function SetOverride(overrides, key, raw, level)
    if not overrides or not key then
        return
    end
    if raw == nil then
        return
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" and raw == 0 then
        return
    end
    if type(raw) == "string" then
        local trimmed = string.gsub(raw, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        if trimmed == "0" then
            return
        end
    end
    local resolved = ResolveEnhanceValue(raw, level)
    if resolved ~= nil then
        overrides[key] = resolved
    end
end

local function SetOverrideWithBase(overrides, key, raw, level, base_value)
    if not overrides or not key then
        return
    end
    if raw == nil then
        return
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" and raw == 0 then
        return
    end
    if type(raw) == "string" then
        local trimmed = string.gsub(raw, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        if trimmed == "0" then
            return
        end
    end
    local resolved = ResolveEnhanceNumber(raw, level, base_value)
    if resolved ~= nil then
        overrides[key] = resolved
    end
end

local function ResolveSourceKey(name, hero_name)
    if not name or name == "" then
        return nil
    end
    if (name == "attack" or name == "ranged_attack") and hero_name and hero_name ~= "" then
        return hero_name .. "_" .. name
    end
    return name
end

local function ItemSourceMatchesName(cfg, raw_item_name)
    if not cfg or not raw_item_name or raw_item_name == "" then
        return false
    end
    local raw = cfg.ItemSource
    if raw == nil or raw == "" then
        return false
    end
    local list = NormalizeList(raw)
    if #list == 0 then
        return false
    end
    for _, item in ipairs(list) do
        if tostring(item) == tostring(raw_item_name) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function CollectProjectileSlots(item_kv, level)
    local slots = {}
    if not item_kv then
        return slots
    end

    local base = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, "ProjectileName", level)
    if base and base ~= "" and base ~= "none" then
        table.insert(slots, { name = base, context = "Projectile" })
    end

    for i = 1, 8 do
        local suffix = (i == 1) and "" or tostring(i)
        local key = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
        if item_kv[key] == nil and i > 2 then
            -- stop scanning once we are past the default slots and no explicit key exists
            if i > 3 then
                break
            end
        end
        local val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        if val and val ~= "" and val ~= "none" then
            table.insert(slots, { name = val, context = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix })
        end
    end

    return slots
end

local function CollectItemSources(item_kv, level)
    local list = {}
    if not item_kv then
        return list
    end

    local hero = item_kv.HeroName
    for _, slot in ipairs(CollectProjectileSlots(item_kv, level)) do
        local src = ResolveSourceKey(slot.name, hero)
        if src and src ~= "" and src ~= "none" then
            table.insert(list, src)
        end
    end

    local function push(key)
        local val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        if val and val ~= "" and val ~= "none" then
            table.insert(list, val)
        end
    end

    push("PassiveName")
    push("PassiveSP")
    push("PassiveSP2")
    for i = 3, 6 do
        push("PassiveSP" .. tostring(i))
    end
    push("AbilitySP")
    push("ModifierSP")

    return list
end

local function GetContextIndexForProjectile(cfg, projectile_name)
    if not cfg then
        return nil
    end
    local targets = NormalizeList(cfg.Projectile)
    if #targets == 0 then
        return 1
    end
    for i, name in ipairs(targets) do
        if tostring(name) == tostring(projectile_name) then
            return i
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function ApplyEnhanceContext(overrides, cfg, level, context, projectile_name, item_kv, item_level)
    if not overrides or not cfg then
        return
    end

    local idx = GetContextIndexForProjectile(cfg, projectile_name)
    if idx == nil then
        return
    end

    local function set_value(prefix, raw)
        SetOverride(overrides, prefix, GetListValueAt(raw, idx), level)
    end

    local function set_number(prefix, raw)
        local base_value = GetBaseStatValue(item_kv, prefix, item_level, overrides)
        SetOverrideWithBase(overrides, prefix, GetListValueAt(raw, idx), level, base_value)
    end

    if context == "Projectile" then
        set_value("ProjectileName", cfg.Projectile)
        set_number("ProjectileInterval", cfg.ProjectileInterval)
        set_number("ProjectileRange", cfg.ProjectileRange)
        set_number("ProjectileBaseDamage", cfg.ProjectileBaseDamage)
        set_value("ProjectileDamageScale", cfg.ProjectileDamageScale)
        set_value("HealPercent", cfg.HealPercent)
        set_value("PurePercent", cfg.PurePercent)
    else
        local suffix = string.sub(context, string.len("ProjectileSP") + 1)
        local prefix = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
        set_value(prefix, cfg.Projectile)
        set_number(prefix .. "Interval", cfg.ProjectileInterval)
        set_number(prefix .. "Range", cfg.ProjectileRange)
        set_number(prefix .. "BaseDamage", cfg.ProjectileBaseDamage)
        set_value(prefix .. "DamageScale", cfg.ProjectileDamageScale)
        set_value(prefix .. "PurePercent", cfg.PurePercent)
    end
end

local function IsEmptyValue(value)
    return value == nil or value == "" or value == "none" or value == "0"
end

local function GetHighestProjectileSlotIndex(item_kv, level, overrides)
    local highest = 0
    for i = 1, 10 do
        local suffix = (i == 1) and "" or tostring(i)
        local key = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
        local val = overrides and overrides[key]
        if val == nil then
            val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        end
        if not IsEmptyValue(val) then
            highest = i
        end
    end
    return highest
end

local function GetNextProjectileSlotKey(item_kv, level, overrides)
    local next_idx = math.max(3, GetHighestProjectileSlotIndex(item_kv, level, overrides) + 1)
    local suffix = (next_idx == 1) and "" or tostring(next_idx)
    return "ProjectileSP" .. suffix, next_idx
end

local function GetNextPassiveSlotKey(item_kv, level, overrides)
    for i = 1, 6 do
        local suffix = (i == 1) and "" or tostring(i)
        local key = "PassiveSP" .. suffix
        local val = overrides and overrides[key]
        if val == nil then
            val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        end
        if IsEmptyValue(val) then
            return key
        end
    end
    return "PassiveSP3"
end

local function ApplyEnhanceExtras(overrides, cfg, level, item_kv, item_level)
    if not overrides or not cfg or not item_kv then
        return
    end

    local additional_list = NormalizeList(cfg.AdditionalProjectile)
    for i, name in ipairs(additional_list) do
        if not IsEmptyValue(name) then
            local slot_key, slot_idx = GetNextProjectileSlotKey(item_kv, item_level, overrides)
            local suffix = (slot_idx == 1) and "" or tostring(slot_idx)

            SetOverride(overrides, slot_key, name, level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "Level", GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileLevel, i),
                level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "Interval",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileInterval, i), level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "Range",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileRange, i), level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "BaseDamage",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileBaseDamage, i), level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "DamageScale",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileDamageScale, i), level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "PurePercent",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalPurePercent, i), level)
        end
    end

    local passive_list = NormalizeList(cfg.Passive)
    for i, name in ipairs(passive_list) do
        if not IsEmptyValue(name) then
            local slot_key = GetNextPassiveSlotKey(item_kv, item_level, overrides)
            SetOverride(overrides, slot_key, name, level)
            SetOverride(overrides, slot_key .. "Level", GetListValueAt(cfg.PassiveLevel, i), level)
        end
    end

    local ability_sp = GetListValueAt(cfg.AbilitySP, 1)
    if not IsEmptyValue(ability_sp) then
        SetOverride(overrides, "AbilitySP", ability_sp, level)
    end

    local modifier_sp = GetListValueAt(cfg.ModifierSP, 1)
    if not IsEmptyValue(modifier_sp) then
        SetOverride(overrides, "ModifierSP", modifier_sp, level)
    end

    SetOverride(overrides, "LifestealSP", GetListValueAt(cfg.LifestealSP, 1), level)
end

local function BuildEffectList(cfg, level, prefix)
    if not cfg then
        return {}
    end
    local name_key = prefix .. "Name"
    local names = NormalizeList(cfg[name_key])
    if #names == 0 then
        return {}
    end

    local list = {}
    for i, raw_name in ipairs(names) do
        local name = tostring(raw_name or "")
        if not IsEmptyValue(name) then
            table.insert(list, {
                name = name,
                interval = ResolveEnhanceValue(GetListValueAt(cfg[prefix .. "Interval"], i), level),
                range = ResolveEnhanceValue(GetListValueAt(cfg[prefix .. "Range"], i), level),
                base_damage = ResolveEnhanceValue(GetListValueAt(cfg[prefix .. "BaseDamage"], i), level),
                damage_scale = ResolveEnhanceValue(GetListValueAt(cfg[prefix .. "DamageScale"], i), level),
                heal_percent = ResolveEnhanceValue(GetListValueAt(cfg[prefix .. "HealPercent"], i), level),
                pure_percent = ResolveEnhanceValue(GetListValueAt(cfg[prefix .. "PurePercent"], i), level),
            })
        end
    end

    return list
end

local function ApplyEnhanceEffects(overrides, cfg, level)
    if not overrides or not cfg then
        return
    end
    local effects = BuildEffectList(cfg, level, "Effect")
    local additional = BuildEffectList(cfg, level, "AdditionalEffect")
    if #effects == 0 and #additional == 0 then
        return
    end

    overrides.__effect_overrides = overrides.__effect_overrides or {
        replace = {},
        additional = {},
    }

    if #effects > 0 then
        for _, entry in ipairs(effects) do
            table.insert(overrides.__effect_overrides.replace, entry)
        end
    end
    if #additional > 0 then
        for _, entry in ipairs(additional) do
            table.insert(overrides.__effect_overrides.additional, entry)
        end
    end
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceKV()
    local kv = Shop1EnhanceKV or {}
    if kv["Shop1 Items Enhance"] then
        kv = kv["Shop1 Items Enhance"]
    end
    return kv
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceConfig(name)
    if not name or name == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local kv = self:GetEnhanceKV()
    return kv and kv[name] or nil
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:BuildSourceIndex()
    self.source_index = {}
    local kv = self:GetEnhanceKV() or {}
    for name, cfg in pairs(kv) do
        local sources = NormalizeList(cfg and cfg.Source)
        for _, src in ipairs(sources) do
            local key = tostring(src)
            if key ~= "" then
                self.source_index[key] = self.source_index[key] or {}
                table.insert(self.source_index[key], name)
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhancesBySource(source_key)
    if not source_key or source_key == "" then
        return {}
    end
    return self.source_index[source_key] or {}
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
    if not cfg then
        return 1
    end
    local stacks = tonumber(cfg.Stacks or 1) or 1
    if stacks == -1 then
        return -1
    end
    if stacks < 1 then
        stacks = 1
    end
    return stacks
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceShopItemId()
    local id = tonumber(self.config and self.config.shop_item_id) or 2
    if id < 1 then
        id = 2
    end
    return id
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetCurrentEnhancePrice(pid)
    local mgr = Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[pid]
    if not mgr or not mgr.GetCurrentPrice then
        return 0, nil
    end
    local id = self:GetEnhanceShopItemId()
    return mgr:GetCurrentPrice(id), mgr
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:ConsumeEnhancePrice(pid)
    local price, mgr = self:GetCurrentEnhancePrice(pid)
    if price <= 0 then
        return true, price, mgr
    end
    local gold = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "gold")
    if gold < price then
        return false, price, mgr, gold
    end
    PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "gold", -price)
    if mgr and mgr.items then
        local id = self:GetEnhanceShopItemId()
        local cfg = mgr.items[id]
        if cfg then
            cfg.buy_count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1
        end
    end
    return true, price, mgr, gold
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:CanStartSelection(pid, opts)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return false, "invalid"
    end

    local force_unlocked = opts and opts.force_unlocked
    if not force_unlocked and not self:IsUnlocked(pid) then
        return false, "locked"
    end

    local state = self:EnsureState(pid)
    if not state then
        return false, "state"
    end

    if state.selection then
        return false, "busy"
    end

    local pool = state.pool_list
    if not pool or #pool == 0 then
        return false, "empty"
    end

    return true, "ok"
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg)
    if not cfg then
        return false
    end
    return tonumber(cfg.Open or 0) == 1
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:HasSourceMatch(item_sources, cfg_sources)
    if not item_sources or not cfg_sources then
        return false
    end
    for _, src in ipairs(cfg_sources) do
        local target = tostring(src)
        if target ~= "" then
            for _, item_src in ipairs(item_sources) do
                if tostring(item_src) == target then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:EnsureState(pid)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return nil
    end
    if not self.states[pid] then
        self.states[pid] = {
            pool_list = {},
            pool_map = {},
            purchased = {},
            selection = nil,
        }
    end
    return self.states[pid]
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:Init()
    if self._event_registered then
        return
    end
    self._event_registered = true

    self:BuildSourceIndex()

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("shop1_enhance_request", function(_, event)
        self:OnEnhanceRequest(event)
    end)

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("shop1_enhance_choice", function(_, event)
        self:OnEnhanceChoice(event)
    end)

end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:InitPlayer(pid)
    self:EnsureState(pid)
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetPurchasedCount(pid, name)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not name then
        return 0
    end
    return state.purchased[name] or 0
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:SetPurchasedCount(pid, name, count)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not name then
        return
    end
    state.purchased[name] = count
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:AddEnhanceToPool(pid, name)
    local state = self:EnsureState(pid)
    if not state or not name or name == "" or name == "none" then
        return false
    end

    if state.pool_map[name] then
        return false
    end

    local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(name)
    if not self:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg) then
        return false
    end

    local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
    if stacks ~= -1 then
        local purchased = self:GetPurchasedCount(pid, name)
        if purchased >= stacks then
            return false
        end
    end

    table.insert(state.pool_list, name)
    state.pool_map[name] = true
    return true
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:AddEnhancesBySource(pid, source_key)
    local changed = false
    for _, name in ipairs(self:GetEnhancesBySource(source_key)) do
        changed = self:AddEnhanceToPool(pid, name) or changed
    end
    return changed
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:RemoveEnhanceFromPool(pid, name)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not name then
        return false
    end
    if not state.pool_map[name] then
        return false
    end
    state.pool_map[name] = nil

    for i = #state.pool_list, 1, -1 do
        if state.pool_list[i] == name then
            table.remove(state.pool_list, i)
            break
        end
    end
    return true
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetPoolList(pid)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state then
        return {}
    end
    return state.pool_list
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:IsUnlocked(pid)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return true
    end
    if not SpawnWallManager or not SpawnWallManager.GetExpansionProgress then
        return true
    end
    local _, _, count = SpawnWallManager:GetExpansionProgress(pid)
    count = tonumber(count or 0) or 0
    return count >= 5
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetClientState(pid)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    local pool_count = (state and state.pool_list and #state.pool_list) or 0
    return {
        unlocked = self:IsUnlocked(pid),
        available = pool_count > 0,
        pool_count = pool_count,
    }
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:OnItemAcquired(pid, raw_item_name, level)
    if not raw_item_name or raw_item_name == "" then
        return false
    end

    local kv = Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[raw_item_name]
    if not kv then
        return false
    end

    local lvl = tonumber(level or 1) or 1
    local changed = false
    for _, src in ipairs(CollectItemSources(kv, lvl)) do
        changed = self:AddEnhancesBySource(pid, src) or changed
    end

    return changed
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetOverrideValues(pid, raw_item_name, level, kv)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not raw_item_name then
        return nil
    end

    local item_kv = kv or (Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[raw_item_name])
    if not item_kv then
        return nil
    end

    local lvl = tonumber(level or 1) or 1
    local item_sources = CollectItemSources(item_kv, lvl)
    local overrides = {}
    local applied = false
    local applied_extra = {}

    for enhance_name, count in pairs(state.purchased or {}) do
        if count and count > 0 then
            local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(enhance_name)
            if self:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg) then
                local cfg_sources = NormalizeList(cfg.Source)
                if self:HasSourceMatch(item_sources, cfg_sources) then
                    local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
                    local enhance_level = (stacks == -1) and count or math.min(count, stacks)
                    for _, slot in ipairs(CollectProjectileSlots(item_kv, lvl)) do
                        ApplyEnhanceContext(overrides, cfg, enhance_level, slot.context, slot.name, item_kv, lvl)
                    end
                    if not applied_extra[enhance_name] then
                        ApplyEnhanceExtras(overrides, cfg, enhance_level, item_kv, lvl)
                        ApplyEnhanceEffects(overrides, cfg, enhance_level)
                        applied_extra[enhance_name] = true
                    end
                    applied = true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if not applied then
        return nil
    end

    return overrides
end

local function InferEnhanceDescType(cfg)
    if not cfg then
        return "text"
    end

    local add_proj = GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectile, 1)
    if add_proj and add_proj ~= "" and add_proj ~= "none" then
        return "compound"
    end

    if cfg.ProjectileInterval or cfg.ProjectileRange or cfg.ProjectileBaseDamage then
        return "values"
    end

    return "text"
end

local function BuildEnhanceDescVars(cfg, level)
    local vars = {}
    if not cfg then
        return vars
    end

    local desc_type = InferEnhanceDescType(cfg)
    if desc_type == "text" then
        return vars
    end

    local function set_var(key, raw)
        local val = ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(raw, level)
        if val ~= nil and val ~= "" then
            vars[key] = val
        end
    end

    if desc_type == "compound" then
        local add_name = GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectile, 1)
        if add_name and add_name ~= "" and add_name ~= "none" then
            vars["additional_projectile"] = "#DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_" .. tostring(add_name)
        end
        set_var("additional_projectile_level", GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileLevel, 1))
        set_var("additional_projectile_interval", GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileInterval, 1))
        set_var("additional_projectile_range", GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileRange, 1))
        set_var("additional_projectile_damage", GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileBaseDamage, 1))
    else
        set_var("interval", cfg.ProjectileInterval)
        set_var("range", cfg.ProjectileRange)
        set_var("damage", cfg.ProjectileBaseDamage)
    end

    return vars
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:BuildChoicePayload(name, pid)
    local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(name) or {}
    local level = 1
    if pid then
        local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
        local purchased = self:GetPurchasedCount(pid, name)
        level = purchased + 1
        if stacks ~= -1 then
            level = math.min(level, stacks)
        end
        if level < 1 then
            level = 1
        end
    end

    local desc_type = InferEnhanceDescType(cfg)
    local display_name = cfg.Name
    local display_desc = cfg.Desc or cfg.Description
    if not display_name or display_name == "" then
        display_name = "#shop1_enhance_" .. tostring(name) .. "_name"
    end
    if not display_desc or display_desc == "" then
        if desc_type == "compound" then
            display_desc = "#shop1_enhance_desc_additional_projectile"
        elseif desc_type == "values" then
            display_desc = "#shop1_enhance_desc_projectile_stats"
        else
            display_desc = "#shop1_enhance_" .. tostring(name) .. "_desc"
        end
    end

    local payload = {
        ability = name or "",
        image = NormalizePanoramaImagePath(cfg.Image),
        display_name = display_name or "",
        display_desc = display_desc or "",
        display_desc_vars = BuildEnhanceDescVars(cfg, level),
    }

    if payload.image == "" and name and name ~= "" then
        payload.image = "s2r://panorama/images/spellicons/" .. name .. "_png.vtex"
    end

    return payload
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:StartSelection(pid, opts)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return
    end

    local force_unlocked = opts and opts.force_unlocked
    if not force_unlocked and not self:IsUnlocked(pid) then
        return
    end

    local state = self:EnsureState(pid)
    if not state or state.selection then
        return
    end

    local pool = state.pool_list
    if not pool or #pool == 0 then
        return
    end

    local temp_pool = {}
    for i, name in ipairs(pool) do
        temp_pool[i] = name
    end

    local choices = {}
    local count = self.config.choice_count or 3
    local item_source = opts and opts.item_source

    local function GetWeightedValue(enhance_name)
        local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(enhance_name)
        local weight = GetEnhanceWeight(cfg)
        if item_source and ItemSourceMatchesName(cfg, item_source) then
            weight = math.min(weight * 2, 1000)
        end
        return weight
    end

    if item_source and #temp_pool > 0 then
        local matching = {}
        for _, name in ipairs(temp_pool) do
            local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(name)
            if ItemSourceMatchesName(cfg, item_source) then
                table.insert(matching, name)
            end
        end
        if #matching > 0 then
            local name = PickWeighted(matching, GetWeightedValue)
            choices[1] = name
            for i = #temp_pool, 1, -1 do
                if temp_pool[i] == name then
                    table.remove(temp_pool, i)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for i = 1, count do
        if choices[i] ~= nil then
            goto continue
        end
        if #temp_pool > 0 then
            local name, idx = PickWeighted(temp_pool, GetWeightedValue)
            choices[i] = name
            if idx then
                table.remove(temp_pool, idx)
            end
        else
            choices[i] = nil
        end
        ::continue::
    end

    state.selection = {
        choices = choices,
    }

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if player then
        local payload = {
            player_id = pid,
            choice_count = count,
            title = "#shop1_enhance_pick_title",
            choices = {},
        }

        for i = 1, count do
            local name = choices[i]
            if name and name ~= "" then
                payload.choices[i] = self:BuildChoicePayload(name, pid)
            else
                payload.choices[i] = {
                    ability = "",
                    image = "s2r://panorama/images/hero_selection/empty_hero_card_png.vtex",
                }
            end
        end

        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_enhance_show", payload)
    end
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:ClearSelection(pid)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if state then
        state.selection = nil
    end
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:SendClose(pid)
    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then
        return
    end
    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_enhance_close", {
        player_id = pid,
    })
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:OnEnhanceRequest(event)
    local pid = event.PlayerID
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return
    end

    local price, mgr = self:GetCurrentEnhancePrice(pid)
    local gold = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "gold")
    if gold < price then
        print("[Shop1Enhance] not enough gold, need", price, "have", gold)
        return
    end

    local ok = self:CanStartSelection(pid)
    if not ok then
        return
    end

    if price > 0 then
        PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "gold", -price)
        if mgr and mgr.items then
            local id = self:GetEnhanceShopItemId()
            local cfg = mgr.items[id]
            if cfg then
                cfg.buy_count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1
            end
        end
        if mgr and mgr.SyncToClient then
            mgr:SyncToClient()
        end
    end

    self:StartSelection(pid, { force_unlocked = true })
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:OnEnhanceChoice(event)
    local pid = event.PlayerID
    local idx = tonumber(event.choice_index or -1)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return
    end

    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not state.selection then
        return
    end

    if idx < 1 then
        return
    end

    local choice = state.selection.choices and state.selection.choices[idx]
    if not choice or choice == "" then
        return
    end

    local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(choice)
    if not self:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg) then
        self:ClearSelection(pid)
        return
    end

    local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
    local purchased = self:GetPurchasedCount(pid, choice) + 1
    if stacks ~= -1 and purchased > stacks then
        purchased = stacks
    end
    self:SetPurchasedCount(pid, choice, purchased)

    if stacks ~= -1 and purchased >= stacks then
        self:RemoveEnhanceFromPool(pid, choice)
    end

    -- Unlock derived enhances chained by Source
    self:AddEnhancesBySource(pid, choice)

    self:ApplyEnhancementsToPlayer(pid)

    self:ClearSelection(pid)
    self:SendClose(pid)
end


function Shop1EnhanceManager:ApplyEnhancementsToPlayer(pid)
    local mgr = Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[pid]
    if not mgr or not mgr.RefreshItemsForEnhance then
        return
    end

    mgr:RefreshItemsForEnhance()

    if mgr.SyncToClient then
        mgr:SyncToClient()
    end
end

    end)

        local pid = keys.PlayerID
        local mgr = SpawnManagers[pid]
        if mgr then

        end
    end)

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("synthesize", function(_, event)
        -- print("[INPUT][Lua] synthesize RECEIVED", event.PlayerID)
        Shop1Managers[event.PlayerID]:HandleSynthesizeByPID()
    end)

    if IsInToolsMode() then
        -- print("[CustomGame] Registering ToolMode commands")
        require('test_mode')

        Convars:RegisterCommand("CustomGameToggleStatsUI", function()
            local pid = 0
            if not pid then return end

            CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(
                PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid),
                "CustomGameToggleStatsUI",
                {}
            )
        end, "ToolMode Toggle Stats UI", 0)

        Convars:RegisterCommand("CustomGameSynthesize", function()
            local pid = 0
            if not pid then return end

            Shop1Managers[pid]:HandleSynthesizeByPID()
        end, "ToolMode Synthesize", 0)

        Convars:RegisterCommand("CustomGameSummon", function()
            local pid = 0
            if not pid then return end

            local mgr = Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[pid]
            if not mgr or not mgr.OnBuyRequest then return end

            mgr:OnBuyRequest({ PlayerID = pid, id = 1 })
        end, "ToolMode Summon", 0)

        Convars:RegisterCommand("CustomGameEnhance", function()
            local pid = 0
            if not pid then return end

            if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.OnEnhanceRequest then
                Shop1EnhanceManager:OnEnhanceRequest({ PlayerID = pid })
            end
        end, "ToolMode Enhance", 0)

        Convars:RegisterCommand("AddItemLevel", function()
            local pid = 0
            if not pid then return end

            local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
            if not player then return end

            local hero = player:GetAssignedHero()
            if not hero then return end

        end, "ToolMode AddItemLevel", 0)

    end
end

function StartCustomGame(level)
    GameState.game_over_flag = false;
    GameState.game_start = true;

    print("[Game Start]")

    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("game_start", {})

    GameState.start_time = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    InitAllPlayerSpawnManagers()
    SelectionSpecial:Init()
    if Shop1EnhanceManager and Shop1EnhanceManager.Init then
        Shop1EnhanceManager:Init()
    end

    if IsInToolsMode() then
        for pid = 0, DOTA_MAX_TEAM_PLAYERS - 1 do
            if PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) and PlayerResource:IsValidPlayer(pid) then
                local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
                if player then
                    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_mouse_bind", {})
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function EndCustomGame(result)
    -- print("[End]", GameState.game_over_flag, GameState.game_start)

    if GameState.game_over_flag then return end
    GameState.game_over_flag = true

    GameState.game_start = false

    print("[Game] EndCustomGame =>", result)

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        ClearAllGroundItems()
        ResetAllHeroes()

        for pid, mgr in pairs(SpawnManagers) do
            if mgr.StopAll then
                mgr:StopAll()
            end
        end

        PlayerStats:Clear()
        StatsManager:Clear()
        PlayerResourceExt:Clear()

        -- 3. 通知 UI
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("game_end", {
            result = result -- "win" / "lose"
        })
    end)
end

function ClearAllGroundItems()
    local drops = Entities:FindAllByClassname("dota_item_drop")

    for _, drop in pairs(drops) do
        if not drop:IsNull() then
            local item = drop:GetContainedItem()
            if item and not item:IsNull() then
                item:RemoveSelf()
            end
            drop:RemoveSelf()
        end
    end
end

function ResetAllHeroes()
    local heroes = HeroList:GetAllHeroes()
    if not heroes then
        return
    end

    local assigned = {}
    local assigned_count = 0
    for pid = 0, DOTA_MAX_TEAM_PLAYERS - 1 do
        if PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) and PlayerResource:IsValidPlayer(pid) then
            local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
            local assigned_hero = player and player:GetAssignedHero() or PlayerResource:GetSelectedHeroEntity(pid)
            if assigned_hero and not assigned_hero:IsNull() then
                local entid = assigned_hero:entindex()
                if not assigned[entid] then
                    assigned[entid] = true
                    assigned_count = assigned_count + 1
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- print("heros", assigned_count)

    for _, hero in ipairs(heroes) do
        if hero:IsRealHero() and not hero:IsTempestDouble() and not hero:IsClone() then
            local pid = hero:GetPlayerID()
            local heroName = hero:GetUnitName()

            -- print("[Shop1Managers]", pid, Shop1Managers, Shop1Managers[pid], hero, hero:GetUnitName())
            Shop1Managers[pid]:DestroyAllItems(hero)

            for i = 0, hero:GetAbilityCount() - 1 do
                local ability = hero:GetAbilityByIndex(i)
                if ability then
                    hero:RemoveAbilityByHandle(ability)
                end
            end

            local modifiers = hero:FindAllModifiers()
            for _, mod in pairs(modifiers) do
                mod:Destroy()
            end

            hero:Stop()

            -- 2. 关闭自动攻击
            hero:SetIdleAcquire(false)
            hero:SetAcquisitionRange(0)

            -- 3. 清空当前攻击目标
            hero:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)

            -- 4. 直接 Kill（非常重要）
            hero:ForceKill(false)

            local newHero = PlayerResource:ReplaceHeroWith(pid, heroName, 0, 0)

            Timers:CreateTimer(0.03, function()
                if newHero and not newHero:IsNull() then
                    local spawn = PlayerSpawnPoint[pid]
                    if spawn then
                        local pos = spawn:GetOrigin()
                        FindClearSpaceForUnit(newHero, pos, true)
                        -- print("Respawn", pos)
                        newHero:SetOrigin(pos)
                    end

                    newHero:Stop()
                    if SpawnWallManager and SpawnWallManager.ResetPlayer then
                        SpawnWallManager:ResetPlayer(pid, newHero)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    Timers:CreateTimer(0.2, function()
        local keep = {}
        for pid = 0, DOTA_MAX_TEAM_PLAYERS - 1 do
            if PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) and PlayerResource:IsValidPlayer(pid) then
                local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
                local assigned_hero = player and player:GetAssignedHero() or PlayerResource:GetSelectedHeroEntity(pid)
                if assigned_hero and not assigned_hero:IsNull() then
                    keep[assigned_hero:entindex()] = true
                end
            end
        end

        local all_heroes = HeroList:GetAllHeroes() or {}
        for _, unit in ipairs(all_heroes) do
            if unit and IsValidEntity(unit) and unit:IsRealHero()
                and not unit:IsTempestDouble() and not unit:IsClone() and not unit:IsSpiritBearCustom()
                and not keep[unit:entindex()] then
                if UTIL_Remove then
                    UTIL_Remove(unit)
                else
                    unit:RemoveSelf()
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

PlayerSpawnPoint = {}

function AssignSpawnPoint(pid)
    if PlayerSpawnPoint[pid] then
        return
    end

    local team = PlayerResource:GetTeam(pid)
    local name = team == DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS
        and "info_player_start_goodguys"
        or "info_player_start_badguys"

    local spawns = Entities:FindAllByClassname(name)

    --print(team, name, #spawns)

    if #spawns == 0 then
        spawns = Entities:FindAllByClassname("info_player_start")
    end

    PlayerSpawnPoint[pid] = spawns[(pid % #spawns) + 1]
end

*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: game/dzsj/scripts/utils/md/enhance_localize.md
@@
+Shop1 enhance localization rules
+
+1) Localization keys
+- display_name: `#shop1_enhance_<enhance_name>_name`
+- display_desc: `#shop1_enhance_<enhance_name>_desc`
+- Config fields `Name`, `Desc`, `Description` are ignored.
+
+2) Desc dialog variables
+- Values are injected into `{s:var}` tokens from:
+  - Enhance KV fields: `ProjectileInterval`, `ProjectileRange`, `ProjectileBaseDamage`,
+    `AdditionalProjectile*` (level/interval/range/base damage).
+  - Passive/AbilitySP/ModifierSP/Item names in enhance KV:
+    for each referenced name, read `Shop1 Items Enhance Passive` from
+    `scripts/npc/item stats/shop1_items_enhance_passive.txt` and merge its key/value
+    pairs into dialog variables.
+- Ability names for `AdditionalProjectile` are localized via
+  `#DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_<ability_name>` and passed as dialog variables.
+- If multiple passive entries define the same key, the first one wins.
+
+3) Percent display conversion
+- If a dialog variable value contains `%`, it is converted to a decimal for display:
+  `50% -> 0.5`, `-20% -> -0.2`.
+- Values without `%` are used as-is.
+
+4) Leveled values
+- If a value is a list (`"1 2 3"` or `"1|2|3"`), the current enhance level (1-based)
+  selects the display value.
+
+5) Gameplay calculations
+- Numeric overrides for stats still follow the gameplay rule:
+  percent values in KV mean `base * (1 + percent/100)`; non-percent values are direct.
*** End Patch

目前机制是“白名单映射”：服务端只把需要的变量组装成 `display_desc_vars` 发给前端，前端只替换 `{s:...}` 中出现的 token。  
这样做有几个原因：  
- 避免把所有配置字段都暴露到 UI（只传必要的）。  
- 允许对不同字段做格式化（比如 `%` 转小数）和特殊本地化（比如能力名转 `#DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_*`）。  
- 让 token 命名稳定，不受 KV 字段改名影响。

如果你希望“直接读配置”，可以改成把整条 KV（或指定前缀）都传给 UI 做替换，但需要确定命名冲突、格式化规则和安全范围。你想要全量透传还是半自动（比如把所有 `Projectile*` 自动映射）？

content.text:
目前机制是“白名单映射”：服务端只把需要的变量组装成 `display_desc_vars` 发给前端，前端只替换 `{s:...}` 中出现的 token。  
这样做有几个原因：  
- 避免把所有配置字段都暴露到 UI（只传必要的）。
